parent_objective: audit the negative wrong/delayed hidden-history action screen before deciding the next causal-history route
blocked_by: M1218 shows reset-hidden action sensitivity but no wrong/delayed matched-history action signal
supersedes: running persistent outcome intervention despite failed action-screen admission
invalidates: claiming current-family hidden-history self-identification from reset-hidden sensitivity alone

public_gates: M1219 may audit M1218 results only
M1219 must explain reset-hidden sensitivity versus wrong/delayed-history insensitivity
M1219 must decide whether to mine action-critical pairs, adjust intervention strength, or redesign training objective
M1219 must not run outcome interventions
M1219 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run outcome intervention gates
do not use hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not treat reset-hidden sensitivity as wrong-history proof

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: H_causal_history_action_screen_negative_audit: route decision after no wrong/delayed signal
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: classifies the M1218 negative action screen and chooses the next causal-history route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: audit only; no outcome training promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if the audit tries to run outcome gates anyway
stop if reset-hidden sensitivity is upgraded to self-ID proof
stop if the next route is left vague
fallback_plan: route to action-critical pair mining if M1217 pairs are not action-critical
route to stronger wrong-history interventions if hidden states are too close
route to training/objective redesign if the current actor is reactive

admission_evidence: M1218 wrong_matched_history mean action distance is 0.001075 with 0 above-threshold rows
M1218 delayed_history mean action distance is 0.000154 with 0 above-threshold rows
M1218 reset_hidden mean action distance is 0.041795 with 629 above-threshold rows
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: next action-critical mining, intervention-strength, or objective-redesign milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1219 must preserve that wrong/delayed matched-history sensitivity was negative despite reset-hidden sensitivity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: No self-identification evidence can be claimed from M1218; the audit chooses the next route.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Record the negative result and use it to redesign mining or objective rather than rerunning outcome gates.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: Auditing the M1218 negative action screen can identify whether the next route should be action-critical mining, stronger history intervention, or training-objective redesign.
success_criteria: M1218 wrong/delayed negative result is summarized
reset-hidden sensitivity is separated from self-identification evidence
no outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
failure_criteria: self-identification is claimed from reset-hidden sensitivity

commands.name: audit_negative_action_screen
commands.command: audit M1218 action-screen results without running outcome gates or training

decision_rule: M1219 passes if it records the negative action-screen evidence and selects a concrete next route without outcome-gate overreach.
